summary: Set out the Fund III fundraising pipeline with six stages and targets for conversion and coverage. Agreed a soft-circle coverage target before launch and an 8-week rule for silent LPs. The June 2027 first close date is still to be confirmed.

discussion.keyPoints: Natalie's tracker mixes stages and has no dates. She estimated about 40% of first meetings turn into data room access.
Richard wants a first close by June 2027. Natalie said average LP decision cycles in Fund II were around 9 months.
Several LPs have gone quiet after the data room. Nobody is sure whether to keep chasing.

recommendations.recommendation: Use six stages: Target, First meeting, Data room, Due diligence, Investment committee, Committed.
Track first meeting to data room and hold it at 40% or better.
Plan for a first close in June 2027 against a 9-month average LP decision cycle.
Hold soft circles of 2.5x the target, around £1.1bn, before formal launch.
Move any LP silent for 8 weeks to a nurture list with quarterly letters only.

actions.action: Rebuild the LP tracker in the six stages with dates

nextFocus: Choose systems and reporting for investor relations.
nextPreparation: Bring the current CRM licence details and the partners meeting pack.
